title: 第1304章 菩提神树第1303章 菩提树变异
content_zh:
此刻，灵兽大嘴正慵懒趴在巨树最粗壮的枝干之上，四肢舒展，姿态闲散。
它怀中抱着一枚体型硕大的菩提果实，大口啃食，吃得津津有味，丝毫没有察觉到陈平的到来。
陈平驻足树下，看着大嘴肆无忌惮偷吃顶级灵果的模样，心底满是无奈。
这是菩提树蜕变新生之后，结出的第一批顶级果实，药性最佳，品相最优，价值极高。
如此珍贵的首茬灵果，竟然被大嘴率先霸占啃食，属实浪费。
大嘴余光瞥见树下的身影，瞬间动作僵硬，连忙停下啃食的动作。
它快速转过身，背对着陈平，脑袋埋在枝叶之间，刻意装作闭目休憩、未曾察觉的模样，试图蒙混过关。
陈平见状，气意翻涌，沉声开口呵斥。
"还不快给我死下来！"
一声厉喝响彻玉佩空间，回荡不绝。
听到陈平的呵斥声，大嘴身躯猛地一颤，不敢再有半点放肆。
它小心翼翼放下手中剩余的菩提果实，耷拉着脑袋，扇动翅膀，慢悠悠从粗壮的树干之上飞落而下。
落地之后，它脑袋低垂，双耳耷拉。
模样委屈怯懦，乖乖站在一旁，不敢抬头直视陈平的目光。
它心底暗自腹诽，觉得自家主人性格小气，不过是吃了一枚普通灵果，便如此严苛斥责，太过较真。
陈平懒得理会大嘴的小心思，踏步走到菩提巨树下方，抬手触碰树干，神识铺开，精准统计菩提树的生长周期与果实成熟时长。
如今玉佩空间的紫土地，有着固定的两千倍时间流速加持，规则稳定，从无偏差。
这批全新的菩提果实，从开花到结果，彻底成熟定型，在外界时间流逝五年。
换算玉佩空间的流速比例，五年外界时光，等同于空间内部整整一万年的培育生长周期。
寻常灵树开花结果，最短数月，最长不过千年。

需要整整一万年才能成熟的果实，世间罕见，远超普通菩提子的生长规格。
陈平心中暗自震动。
寻常菩提树，绝对不可能需要万年时长才能结果成熟。
唯一的解释，就是整片菩提树群落，在集体突破十万年药龄的那一刻，彻底完成物种进阶。
普通菩提树，成功蜕变升级，极有可能蜕变成世间独一份的菩提神树。
也只有先天灵根层级的神树，才会拥有如此漫长的结果周期，才能孕育出品级超脱的顶级果实。
想到这里，陈平心底明朗。
他栽种在玉佩空间的各类灵药，历经十二万年药龄滋养，绝大部分都已经顺利进阶，蜕变成先天灵根，底蕴十足。
唯独菩提树、养魂树、葫芦藤寥寥几株灵物，始终卡在普通灵树层级，迟迟没有完成最终进阶。
如今菩提树终于补齐短板，成功蜕变，晋升先天灵根，成为菩提神树。
传闻之中，菩提神树所结的果实，名为菩提神子，药性远超普通菩提子，层级完全不同。
最核心的功效，并非提升修为、滋养灵力，而是果实内部天然孕育菩提心。
content_en:
At this moment, the spirit beast Big Mouth was lying lazily on the thickest branch of the giant tree, with its limbs stretched out and its posture relaxed.
It held a large bodhi fruit in its arms and ate it with gusto, without noticing Chen Ping's arrival.
Chen Ping stopped under the tree, feeling helpless as he watched Big Mouth eating top-notch spiritual fruits unscrupulously.
This is the first batch of top-quality fruits produced by the Bodhi tree after its transformation and rebirth. It has the best medicinal properties, the best appearance, and extremely high value.
It is really a waste that such a precious first crop of spiritual fruit is taken over by Big Mouth.
Dazui caught a glimpse of the figure under the tree from the corner of his eye. His movements froze for a moment and he quickly stopped eating.
It quickly turned around, its back facing Chen Ping, its head buried among the branches and leaves, deliberately pretending to have its eyes closed and resting, not noticing, trying to get through.
When Chen Ping saw this, he became angry and scolded him in a deep voice.
"Why don't you die quickly!"
A sharp shout resounded through the jade pendant space, echoing endlessly.
Hearing Chen Ping's scolding, Da Zui's body trembled suddenly, not daring to be any more presumptuous.
It carefully put down the remaining bodhi fruit in its hand, lowered its head, flapped its wings, and slowly flew down from the thick trunk.
After landing, its head drooped and its ears drooped.
He looked aggrieved and cowardly, standing aside obediently, not daring to raise his head and look directly into Chen Ping's eyes.
It secretly cursed in its heart, feeling that its master was stingy and it was too serious to reprimand him so harshly just for eating an ordinary spiritual fruit.
Chen Ping was too lazy to pay attention to Big Mouth's little thoughts, stepped under the giant Bodhi tree, raised his hand to touch the trunk, and spread his consciousness to accurately calculate the growth cycle of the Bodhi tree and the maturity time of the fruit.
Nowadays, the purple earth in the Jade Pendant Space has a fixed time flow rate of two thousand times, and the rules are stable and there is no deviation.
These brand-new Bodhi fruits, from flowering to fruiting, are completely mature and finalized, and five years have passed in the outside world.
Calculating the flow rate ratio of the jade pendant space, five years of external time is equivalent to a full ten thousand year cultivation and growth cycle inside the space.
Ordinary spiritual trees can bloom and bear fruit in a few months at the earliest and no more than a thousand years at the longest.
The fruit, which takes a full ten thousand years to mature, is rare in the world and far exceeds the growth specifications of ordinary Bodhi seeds.
Chen Ping was secretly shocked.
It is absolutely impossible for an ordinary bodhi tree to take ten thousand years to mature.
The only explanation is that the entire Bodhi tree community completely completed species advancement at the moment when they collectively exceeded the age of 100,000 years.
An ordinary bodhi tree, if successfully transformed and upgraded, will most likely transform into the only sacred bodhi tree in the world.
Only the sacred trees at the innate spiritual root level can have such a long fruiting cycle and can produce top-level fruits of extraordinary quality.
Thinking of this, Chen Ping felt clear in his heart.
The various elixirs he planted in the jade pendant space have been nourished for 120,000 years, and most of them have successfully advanced and transformed into innate spiritual roots, with full foundation.
Only the bodhi tree, the soul-nurturing tree, and the gourd vine are only a few spiritual objects, which are always stuck at the level of ordinary spiritual trees, and have yet to complete the final advancement.
Now the Bodhi tree has finally made up for its shortcomings, successfully transformed, promoted its innate spiritual roots, and become the Bodhi tree.
According to rumors, the fruit produced by the Bodhi Tree is called Bodhi Seed. Its medicinal properties are far superior to ordinary Bodhi Seed, and its levels are completely different.
The core effect is not to improve cultivation and nourish spiritual power, but to naturally nurture bodhicitta within the fruit.
